title: Keep typed outcome-unknown result when post-dispatch connection cleanup fails
outcome: A post-dispatch transport loss still returns daemon_request_outcome_unknown even when disposal raises a non-transport exception.
acceptance: A failDispose regression on the dispatched failure path retains the typed non-retryable outcome-unknown response, never replays the original call, clears only the failed connection, and permits the next call to use a working connection.

completion.summary: Post-dispatch client/stream cleanup preserves typed non-retryable uncertain outcome, no replay and replacement identity; test-first and mutation evidence, full gates and fresh dual review complete. Distinct in-flight shutdown Medium remains tracked separately.
